question.text: If <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>a</mi><mo>,</mo><mo> </mo><mi>b</mi></math> and <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>c</mi></math> are distinct positive real numbers such that <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msub><mi mathvariant="normal">Δ</mi><mn>1</mn></msub><mo>=</mo><mfenced close="|" open="|" separators="|"><mtable columnalign="left"><mtr><mtd><mi>a</mi></mtd><mtd><mi>b</mi></mtd><mtd><mi>c</mi></mtd></mtr><mtr><mtd><mi>b</mi></mtd><mtd><mi>c</mi></mtd><mtd><mi>a</mi></mtd></mtr><mtr><mtd><mi>c</mi></mtd><mtd><mi>a</mi></mtd><mtd><mi>b</mi></mtd></mtr></mtable></mfenced></math> and <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msub><mi mathvariant="normal">Δ</mi><mn>2</mn></msub><mo>=</mo><mfenced close="|" open="|" separators="|"><mtable columnalign="left"><mtr><mtd><mi>b</mi><mi>c</mi><mo>-</mo><msup><mi>a</mi><mn>2</mn></msup></mtd><mtd><mi>a</mi><mi>c</mi><mo>-</mo><msup><mi>b</mi><mn>2</mn></msup></mtd><mtd><mi>a</mi><mi>b</mi><mo>-</mo><msup><mi>c</mi><mn>2</mn></msup></mtd></mtr><mtr><mtd><mi>a</mi><mi>c</mi><mo>-</mo><msup><mi>b</mi><mn>2</mn></msup></mtd><mtd><mi>a</mi><mi>b</mi><mo>-</mo><msup><mi>c</mi><mn>2</mn></msup></mtd><mtd><mi>b</mi><mi>c</mi><mo>-</mo><msup><mi>a</mi><mn>2</mn></msup></mtd></mtr><mtr><mtd><mi>a</mi><mi>b</mi><mo>-</mo><msup><mi>c</mi><mn>2</mn></msup></mtd><mtd><mi>b</mi><mi>c</mi><mo>-</mo><msup><mi>a</mi><mn>2</mn></msup></mtd><mtd><mi>a</mi><mi>c</mi><mo>-</mo><msup><mi>b</mi><mn>2</mn></msup></mtd></mtr></mtable></mfenced></math>, then

solution.text:
Elements of Δ2 are co-factors of the elements of Δ1 
Hence Δ12=Δ2
